// ============================================
//  Home Santayanon ESP32 Firmware
//  ค่าจริงจากบอร์ด — อัปเดตทันทีทุกครั้ง
// ============================================

#include <WiFi.h>
#include <PubSubClient.h>
#include <DHT.h>
#include <IRremoteESP8266.h>
#include <PZEM004Tv30.h>

struct SystemState state;

void setup() {
    Serial.begin(115200);
    pinMode(GPIO4, INPUT);
    pinMode(GPIO23, OUTPUT);
    pinMode(GPIO14, OUTPUT);
    pinMode(GPIO15, OUTPUT);
    pinMode(GPIO16, OUTPUT);
    pinMode(GPIO17, OUTPUT);
    pinMode(GPIO18, OUTPUT);
    pinMode(GPIO19, OUTPUT);
    dht.begin();
    irsend.begin();
    Serial2.begin(9600, SERIAL_8N1, GPIO21, GPIO22);
    WiFi.begin("Santayanon", "********");
    mqttClient.connect("ESP32_Santayanon_01");
}

void loop() {
    mqttClient.loop();
    float tempC = dht.readTemperature();   // --.- °C
    float humidity = dht.readHumidity();   // --.- %
    float voltage = pzem.voltage();      // --- V
    float currentAmp = pzem.current();    // 0.00 A
    float loadPercent = (currentAmp/12)*100; // 0 %
    float todayKwh += powerW/1000*dt;   // 0.000 kWh
    float todayCost = todayKwh*9.00f;   // 0.00 บาท
    mqttClient.publish("santayanon/home/status", json);
    delay(50);
}
